reason: The immediate goal is a stable site, so clearing the return-plant ground with the excavator seems like a useful first step.
expectation: I expect the excavator to clear or level the ground, though further preparation may be needed.

alternatives.reason: The spare solar modules will likely supply the plant, but preparing the site seems more immediate.

effect: The excavator graded the ground, so I can now prepare its surface.
reaction: The result was predictable, but it made clear progress toward the site.
reason: Ceramic blocks on the graded site seem useful for making a stable plant base.
expectation: I expect the blocks to form a level foundation or paving for the plant.

alternatives.reason: The solar modules will likely be needed for power, but the site comes first.

effect: The footing completes the stable site, and the next goal is to power propellant production.
reaction: The blocks spreading the equipment loads made the foundation feel physically sensible.
reason: The spare solar modules need support, so combining them with steel seems like a direct way to add power.
expectation: I expect a supported solar array, probably still needing an electrical connection.

effect: The spare modules now have a rack and can be connected to power the plant.
reaction: The rack was the expected intermediate step.
reason: Connecting the cable to the rack directly advances the power goal.
expectation: I expect a connected solar supply for the return plant, though it may need further installation.

effect: The connected rack completes the power goal; its controller preserves the growing room's allocation while supplying slower fuel production.
reaction: The shared-power detail made the result more meaningful than a generic solar connection.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the industrial supply was most worthwhile: the result explained how the new load fits alongside the growing room and established the next stage of the return plan.

leastWorthwhile.text: Grading the site was predictable and produced little detail on its own, although it was a sensible first step.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the result to specify that fuel production would be much slower and the growing room would retain its allotted power.

arbitrary.text: None of my chosen actions felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to the site or power goal.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the local-propellant contingency works and how the discovery gets back to Earth. This chapter's preparation was sensible, though mostly predictable.
